column1: # Partition table for the 16MB ESP32-S3 board.
# Two app slots so the board can update itself over WiFi. That is not a luxury
# here: flashing this board over USB takes minutes and fails partway often
# enough that we split the image into chunks to get it done at all. Over the
# air it is one transfer to a slot that is not running

column2: and a bad image just boots the old slot again.

column1: # 4MB per slot against a ~1MB firmware leaves generous headroom for a scripting
# engine and assets later. The rest is storage for scripts
